title: Pointwise shift compatibility of the refinement-restriction map
statement:
For every integer n and M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X (R.ring X)),
(((((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ push R r.hom) ⋙ pull R d.i).commShiftIso n).hom.app M ≫
  (refinementRestriction R r hi M)⟦n⟧') =
  refinementRestriction R r hi ((shiftFunctor _ n).obj M) ≫
    (((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ pull R c.i).commShiftIso n).hom.app M.

proof.text: Expand refinementRestriction as the normalized refinement pullback compositor followed by the derived proper adjunction counit. The compositor is the exact pullback composition isomorphism and the counit is the canonical right-derived adjunction counit; the corresponding shift squares commute, and their composite is the displayed pointwise equation.

      pull R d.i).commShiftIso n).hom.app M ≫
      (refinementRestriction R r hi M)⟦n⟧' =
    refinementRestriction R r hi ((shiftFunctor _ n).obj M) ≫
      (((openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory ⋙ pull R c.i).commShiftIso n).hom.app M
